Weserstadion is a football stadium in Bremen, Germany. The Weserstadion is scenically situated on the north bank of the Weser River and is surrounded by lush green parks (the name 'Werder' is a regional German word for "river peninsula"). It is the home stadium of German Bundesliga club Werder Bremen. Opened in 1924, this oldest stadium has a capacity of around 42,100-43,087 spectators, provides luxurious VIP rooms, and serves as a hub for sporting and music events. Long History: The stadium has been used by SV Werder Bremen since 1909, making it one of the oldest sporting venues in Germany. Nordderby Match Center: Home to the fierce rivalry between Werder Bremen and Hamburger SV. Museum & Tours: There is a club museum and stadium tours to learn about Werder Bremen's history.
